title: JWT 'none' algorithm (json) — review required
description: Configuration or code in json names the JWT 'none' algorithm: "alg"s*:s*"none". Tokens without signatures are accepted as genuine, so anyone can mint them. This lexical rule flags the name; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or removes it.
remediation: Require a signature algorithm (HS256/RS256 pinning) and reject 'none' explicitly in verification.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the name regardless of context.
